Identities:
# Identities
## What the theme covers
Identities explores the nature of the self and what it is to be human. Recommended topics are lifestyles, health and well-being, beliefs and values, subcultures, and language and identity.

## Useful language
Describe yourself with ich bin and ich halte mich für. Give opinions with meiner Meinung nach, ich finde, dass and ich glaube, dass; remember that dass sends the verb to the end of the clause. Talk about change with früher + Präteritum and jetzt + Präsens: früher aß ich ungesund, aber jetzt esse ich gesund.

## Ideas to discuss
Dialects and regional identity in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, multilingual Switzerland, the identity of people with a Migrationshintergrund, and social media and self-image.

## Key terms
der Lebensstil: lifestyle, way of life
die Gesundheit: health, being healthy
das Wohlbefinden: well-being, feeling well
die Werte: values, principles
der Glaube: belief, faith
gehören zu: to belong to
das Selbstbewusstsein: self-confidence, self-assurance
Experiences:
# Experiences
## What the theme covers
Experiences explores the events that shape our lives. Recommended topics are leisure activities, holidays and travel, life stories, rites of passage, customs and traditions, and migration.

## Useful language
Narrate the past with the Perfekt in speech (ich bin nach Berlin gefahren) and the Präteritum in writing (ich fuhr nach Berlin). Verbs of movement and change usually take sein in the Perfekt. Use the Plusquamperfekt for an earlier past: ich hatte Wien schon besucht. Use the Konjunktiv II for wishes: wenn ich Geld hätte, würde ich reisen.

## Ideas to discuss
Festivals such as Karneval, Oktoberfest and Christmas markets, the Abitur as a rite of passage, the gap year, and migration to Germany.

## Key terms
die Freizeit: leisure, free time
die Reise: the trip, the journey
der Brauch: custom, tradition
die Auswanderung: emigration, leaving one’s country
die Erinnerung: memory, remembrance
das Erlebnis: an experience, an event lived through
Human ingenuity:
# Human ingenuity
## What the theme covers
Human ingenuity explores how human creativity and innovation affect our world. Recommended topics are entertainment, artistic expressions, communication and media, technology, and scientific innovation.

## Useful language
Weigh pros and cons with einerseits… andererseits, der Vorteil ist, dass and der Nachteil ist, dass. Use subordinate clauses with weil, obwohl and wenn, which send the verb to the end. Use connectives such as jedoch, trotzdem, außerdem and deshalb; after deshalb and trotzdem the verb comes second.

## Ideas to discuss
Social media and screen time, artificial intelligence, German inventions such as the printing press and the car, and German-language film and music.

## Key terms
die sozialen Medien: social media
die künstliche Intelligenz: artificial intelligence
die Erfindung: the invention
die Unterhaltung: entertainment, amusement
der Fortschritt: progress, advancement
jedoch: however, nevertheless
Social organization:
# Social organization
## What the theme covers
Social organization explores how groups of people organize themselves. Recommended topics are social relationships, community, social engagement, education, the working world, and law and order.

## Useful language
Use relative clauses with der, die and das, which send the verb to the end: die Schule, die ich besuche. Express obligation with müssen and sollen. Make suggestions with man sollte and es wäre besser, wenn. Use the passive with werden: die Gesetze werden geändert.

## Ideas to discuss
The German school system (Grundschule, Gymnasium, Realschule, Hauptschule), dual vocational training (die duale Ausbildung), volunteering, and the work–life balance.

## Key terms
die Gemeinschaft: the community
das Ehrenamt: volunteering, unpaid work
die Ausbildung: vocational training, apprenticeship
die Arbeitslosigkeit: unemployment, being out of work
der Streik: a strike, industrial action
das Gesetz: the law
Sharing the planet:
# Sharing the planet
## What the theme covers
Sharing the planet explores the challenges and opportunities faced by individuals and communities. Recommended topics are the environment, human rights, peace and conflict, equality, globalization, ethics, and urban and rural environment.

## Useful language
Persuade with wir müssen, man sollte and es ist dringend notwendig, dass. Use the Konjunktiv II for hypotheses: wenn alle recycelten, gäbe es weniger Müll. Use um… zu for purpose: um die Umwelt zu schützen.

## Ideas to discuss
Germany's Energiewende and recycling system, climate protests such as Fridays for Future, integration of refugees, and life in the city compared with the countryside.

## Key terms
die Umwelt: the environment
der Klimawandel: climate change
der Müll: rubbish, waste
die Energiewende: the energy transition, the move to renewables
die Menschenrechte: human rights
die Gleichberechtigung: equality, equal rights
nachhaltig: sustainable, long-lasting
Paper 1: writing:
# Paper 1: writing
## The paper
Paper 1 is a writing paper. You choose one of three tasks and write a text of the type asked for: at SL 250–400 words in 1 hour 15 minutes, at HL 450–600 words in 1 hour 30 minutes. It is marked on language, message and conceptual understanding.

## Text types
Text types include the article, blog, email, letter, speech, diary entry, review, interview, brochure, report and proposal. Use the conventions of each type. Match the register to the audience: du for friends and Sie for formal writing. Formal letters open with Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren and close with Mit freundlichen Grüßen.

## Tips
Plan purpose, audience and context first. Check word order (verb second in main clauses, verb last in subordinate clauses), cases and adjective endings.

## Key terms
das Register: register, the level of formality
der Empfänger: the recipient, the audience
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren: formal letter greeting, Dear Sir or Madam
Mit freundlichen Grüßen: formal sign-off, Yours faithfully
Paper 2: listening and reading:
# Paper 2: listening and reading
## The paper
Paper 2 tests receptive skills. The listening section uses three audio texts; the reading section uses three written texts. Questions include multiple choice, true or false with justification, gap-filling, matching and short answers.

## Strategies
Read the questions before you listen or read. Look for synonyms and paraphrases rather than identical words. In true/false questions, the justification must be the words from the text. Watch for negatives such as nicht mehr, nie and kein, and for separable verbs whose prefix comes at the end of the clause.

## Key terms
richtig oder falsch: true or false
begründen Sie: justify, give evidence
nicht mehr: no longer, not any more
trennbares Verb: separable verb, a verb whose prefix moves to the end
Individual oral:
# Individual oral
## The assessment
The individual oral is the internal assessment. At SL you describe and discuss a visual stimulus linked to a theme; at HL you discuss an extract from one of the literary works you studied. It includes a presentation of up to 4 minutes, a follow-up discussion, and a general conversation on at least one other theme.

## How to do well
Link the stimulus to the theme and to the German-speaking world. Use varied vocabulary and structures, and develop opinions. Use fillers such as also, na ja and eigentlich naturally, and ask for clarification if needed: könnten Sie das bitte wiederholen?

## Key terms
beschreiben: to describe
im Vordergrund: in the foreground
im Hintergrund: in the background
könnten Sie das wiederholen?: could you repeat that?
Literary works:
# Literary works
## Literature at HL
HL students study two literary works in German. Literature helps you explore the themes in depth and builds vocabulary and cultural understanding. The HL individual oral discusses an extract from one of these works.

## Talking about literature
Discuss the plot (die Handlung), the characters (die Figuren), the narrator (der Erzähler), the setting, the themes and the author's style. Use the present tense to describe events. Support points with short quotations and explain their effect. Popular works include Die Verwandlung by Kafka, Der Besuch der alten Dame by Dürrenmatt and Der Vorleser by Schlink.

## Key terms
die Handlung: the plot
die Figur: the character
der Erzähler: the narrator
der Auszug: the extract
das Thema: the theme
